flows.flow_name: Flow 16 (name TBD) - Seller onboarding and profile view
flows.action: GET /sellers/check-shop-name - live shop-name uniqueness check while filling in the apply form
flows.data: Candidate shop name typed into the apply form
flows.expected: 200, availability flag for the candidate shop name (not independently audited yet - endpoint order inferred from path semantics, not confirmed via call-site tracing)

flows.data: Shop name, category, address, etc. per CreateSellerApplicationDto (not independently audited yet)
flows.expected: 201/200, application created; isSeller remains false until approval/confirmation completes (not independently audited yet)

flows.action: GET /sellers/confirm/:token - seller clicks the email confirmation link
flows.data: Confirmation token from the application email
flows.expected: 200/redirect, account confirmed, isSeller flips to true (not independently audited yet)

flows.action: POST /sellers/resend-confirmation - alternate/fallback branch if the confirmation token expired or was never received (not strictly sequential with step 3)
flows.expected: 200, a new confirmation email/token issued (not independently audited yet)

flows.action: GET /sellers/me - seller views their own profile for the first time after onboarding completes (mobile: ShopDetails.tsx, SellerSettings.tsx; web: app/seller/layout.tsx, app/seller/settings/page.tsx)
flows.expected: 200 with full profile DTO (isSeller:true, sellerProfile fields populated); see TC-109-001

flows.action: PATCH /sellers/profile - seller edits shop name/profile fields from Settings
flows.data: Updated shop name/profile fields (not independently audited yet)
flows.expected: 200, profile updated; a subsequent GET /sellers/me (step 5) would reflect the change (not independently audited yet)

flows.action: GET /sellers/me - profile bootstrap on Seller Hub Home/dashboard load (mobile: useSellerDashboard.ts:220,246; web: app/seller/layout.tsx:161-178, app/seller/page.tsx:210)
flows.expected: 200 with full profile DTO, primes the shared profile cache used by the rest of the dashboard

flows.expected: 200 with aggregated order stats (not independently audited yet)

flows.action: GET /sellers/me/orders/chart - dashboard order-chart tile (not independently audited yet)
